options.onRender: function fb(b){b=b||0;if(b>=1073741824)return (b/1073741824).toFixed(2)+' GiB';if(b>=1048576)return (b/1048576).toFixed(0)+' MiB';return (b/1024).toFixed(0)+' KiB';}var m={},lbl={};try{if(data&&data.series){data.series.forEach(function(s){var vf=null;if(s.fields){for(var i=0;i<s.fields.length;i++){var fd=s.fields[i];if(fd.type==='number')vf=fd;if(fd.labels){for(var k in fd.labels){if(fd.labels[k])lbl[k]=fd.labels[k];}}}}if(vf){var vs=vf.values;var v=Array.isArray(vs)?vs[vs.length-1]:(vs&&vs.get?vs.get(vs.length-1):0);m[s.refId]=v||0;}});}}catch(e){}function set(id,t){var el=htmlNode.querySelector(id);if(el)el.textContent=t;}var up=m.D||0;var dd=Math.floor(up/86400),hh=Math.floor((up%86400)/3600),mm=Math.floor((up%3600)/60);set('#v-host',lbl.server||lbl.instance||lbl.nodename||'--');set('#v-up',dd+' dias, '+hh+' h '+mm+' min');set('#v-os',(lbl.pretty_name||lbl.name||'Linux'));set('#v-load',(m.E||0).toFixed(2)+'  (1m)   '+(m.F||0).toFixed(2)+'  (5m)   '+(m.G||0).toFixed(2)+'  (15m)');set('#v-kernel',(lbl.release||'--')+'  '+(lbl.machine||''));set('#v-procs',Math.round(m.P||0));set('#v-cpu',Math.round(m.C||0)+' núcleos ('+(lbl.machine||'')+')');set('#v-mem',fb(m.I)+' usados / '+fb(m.J)+' em cache / '+fb(m.H)+' total');set('#v-swap',fb(m.L)+' usados / '+fb(m.K)+' total');set('#v-disk',fb(m.N)+' usados / '+fb(m.O)+' livres / '+fb(m.M)+' total');
